description: Searches published catalog components to find IDs for board authoring or get_part. Supplied filters apply together; query ranks matching candidates, while factQuery only selects cached facts for those candidates. An optional boardId applies that board’s strict Part List restriction, when enabled. Guest access uses guestToken and excludes organization access.

boardId.description: Optional saved board ID. Enforces that board’s strict Part List when enabled; omit to use the full published catalog.

category.description: Exact catalog category; omit when unknown.

factQuery.description: Cached-fact terms only; requires query. Omit for filter-only searches. It never changes which parts match.

guestToken.description: Private guest-session capability returned by start_guest_session. Never print it or save it in a repository.

jlcpcbBasic.description: Restrict to JLCPCB Basic parts when true; false or omission leaves this filter unset.

limit.description: Maximum catalog candidates to return, from 1 to 20; defaults to 3.

mountingType.description: smt: surface mount; tht: through-hole; mixed: both.

package.description: Exact catalog label; use query for package families.

query.description: PCB selection terms: MPN, manufacturer, description or package family. For exact MPNs omit unverified categories unless user-required. Preserve explicit filters and Part Lists; factQuery does not select parts. Required when factQuery is supplied.

subcategory.description: Exact catalog subcategory, such as chip_resistor, mlcc, or ldo.

name: search_parts
title: Search published parts
